# Session (web)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`public-site`](../../flows/public-site/FLOW.md), [`sign-in`](../../flows/sign-in/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Holds the visitor's session (anonymous, a reader account, or a reviewer session) for the whole site, and the auth calls behind it ([sign-in flow](../../flows/sign-in/FLOW.md)). Today's web calls cms-api from the browser (D14); D21 (feature web-bff-hardening, not built yet) moves every browser call to the BFF under `/bff/v1`, so this module changes then ([web rules](../../apps/web/RULES.md)).

## Techniques

A client context: one silent refresh on mount settles `unknown` into `anonymous` or `authenticated`; an account session refreshes through the refresh cookie, a reviewer session holds only an access token. Accounts with any permission other than `read` are refused (`PrivilegedAccessError`).

## Technologies

React context, Axios.

## Entry points

Facade `index.ts`: `WebSessionProvider`, `useWebSession`, `PrivilegedAccessError` and the session types.

## Where to change what

A new auth call: `Auth.api.ts`; session state: `WebSession.context.tsx`. Other features import only the facade.
